articles.title: Trump pushes Apple to change 'Lake Ontario' to 'Lake America' on its maps - BBC
articles.description: The request comes after Google made the switch for US-based users over the weekend. MapQuest, another US map provider, said it will not change the name.
articles.content: Google made the switch for its US-based users over the weekend, though users in Canada still see the lake, which borders the province of Ontario and the state of New York, as Lake Ontario.
